name: mirza-marketplace
description: Mirza's custom Claude Code plugins. Fork of selected plugins from claude-plugins-official with personal modifications.

plugins.name: telegram
plugins.description: Custom Telegram channel for Claude Code. Forked from the official Telegram plugin, with per-project state, a registry-driven slash menu, /context that shows context window plus session info plus effort level, /version that lists installed plugin and wrapper versions (telegram, pty-controller, mirza-cc, agent-bus — all resolved dynamically), /delete (safe-default soft delete; /delete hard for permanent), Prev/Next pagination across the session pickers, /effort picker to set Claude's reasoning depth from a phone, quoted-message context forwarded inline to the agent, and get_message_by_id MCP tool for fetching older messages (text + attachments) by ID.

plugins.name: immediate-reply
plugins.description: Behavioral skill that makes Claude feel fast on Telegram by sending an instant acknowledgement before any non-trivial work.

plugins.name: inline-buttons
plugins.description: Behavioral skill (renamed from interactive-prompts) that forces a self-audit before every Telegram reply: replies that ask a question MUST carry inline-keyboard buttons — minimum Yes/No plus a final manual-fallback button — so the user answers with one tap. Requires telegram >= 0.0.9-mirza.0.

plugins.name: teach-me
plugins.description: Behavioral skill that activates when the user wants to be taught a concept they don't yet understand. Builds understanding from fundamentals up — mirrors user's analogies, confirms and sharpens rather than corrects, holds off action until the foundation is solid.

plugins.name: daily-report
plugins.description: Slash command + skill that produce a paste-ready plain-text daily work report from recent git activity and a free-form prompt — provider-agnostic, works with any chat app. Locked Yesterday/Today template with anti-fabrication rules.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Session handoff toolkit. /handoff captures the current session into a structured 10-section markdown file in <repo>/.handoff/; /handoff-resume loads the latest handoff in a new session, summarises it, and proceeds after user confirmation.

plugins.name: pty-controller
plugins.description: Programmatically inject slash commands into a running Claude Code session by going through a companion wrapper process (mirza-cc) that hosts CC inside a node-pty pseudo-terminal. Provides the /new slash command (clears the session via PTY) and the pty_send_slash / pty_status MCP tools. Requires the mirza-cc wrapper running — see plugin README. Pairs well with the telegram plugin (the wrapper drops a session-change event into telegram's outbox so the user gets a post-/clear ping; the telegram plugin owns the /notify-user command itself).

plugins.name: bot-conduct
plugins.description: Behavioral skill encoding working rules for agent bots: git worktrees instead of branch-switching, commits signed with the bot's identity (Agent: <bot-name> trailer), subagent-first delegation so the main loop stays responsive, and a shared cross-bot playbook at ~/.claude/agent-playbook/PLAYBOOK.md for proven practices and past mistakes.

plugins.name: agent-bus
plugins.description: Bot-to-bot messaging for Claude Code. Lets one registered agent send another a one-way slash command or a natural-language prompt (broadcast-capable to many peers at once) via a per-peer filesystem inbox, coordinated through the shared ~/.claude/agent-registry.json. Provides the agent_list / agent_status / agent_send MCP tools. Prompts arrive at the peer as an inbound channel message and are acted on automatically; there is no reply protocol (loops are prevented by an anti-bounce skill rule plus a hop-count cap). Builds on pty-controller's registry and the mirza-cc wrapper; pairs with the telegram plugin for richer peer status.
